content.text:
FIM is supported by the **Codestral** model family — Mistral's dedicated code model:

- **Codestral (25.01)** — "specializes in low-latency, high-frequency tasks such as fill-in-the-middle (FIM), code correction and test generation." [1]
- **Codestral (25.08)**, the latest version (July 2025) — "specializes in low-latency, high-frequency tasks such as fill-in-the-middle (FIM) and code generation." [2]

It's queried via a dedicated FIM completion endpoint (`/v1/fim/completions`) rather than the standard chat/completions endpoint. [3][4]

Sources:
1. https://docs.mistral.ai/models/codestral-25-01
2. https://docs.mistral.ai/models/codestral-25-08
3. https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/deployment/cloud-deployments/outscale#querying-the-model-fim
4. https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/deployment/cloud-deployments/vertex#querying-the-model-fim
